description: This file contains the Hibernate implementation of the Patient Data Access Object (DAO) for the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching for Patient entities, as well as related entities like PatientIdentifier, Allergy, and PatientProgram. The class interacts with Hibernate sessions and uses criteria and query mechanisms to perform database operations specific to patient data management within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: HibernatePatientDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the PatientDAO interface, providing database operations for Patient-related entities within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient entity by its internal database ID.

methods.name: savePatient
methods.description: Creates or updates a Patient entity in the database.

methods.name: getPatientByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifier by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifierType by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllergies
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided allergies associated with a specific patient.

methods.name: getAllergyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the allergy status string from the patient record.

methods.name: saveAllergies
methods.description: Saves or updates allergies information for a patient.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Retrieves an Allergy entity by its ID.

methods.name: getAllergyByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Allergy entity by its UUID.

methods.name: saveAllergy
methods.description: Saves an Allergy entity to the database.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByProgram
methods.description: Fetches patient identifiers associated with a specific patient program.
